items.q: What do I need to provide?

items.q: I don't have photos, is that a problem?

onboarding.subtitle: Fill in your business information so we can create your optimized Google Business Profile.
onboarding.secure_note: Your data is secure and will only be used to create your Google Business Profile.
onboarding.save_fail: Error while saving. Please try again.
onboarding.s1_subtitle: Enter the main details of your business. They will be used to create a Google Business Profile that faithfully reflects your establishment.
onboarding.s1_section1_subtitle: Enter the main details of your business. They will be used to create a Google Business Profile that faithfully reflects your establishment.
onboarding.s1_nom_commercial_hint: Enter the name your customers know, the one displayed on your sign.
onboarding.s1_nom_legal_hint: If your legal entity name differs from your trade name, enter it here.
onboarding.s1_categorie_principale_hint: Select the main activity that best represents your business.
onboarding.s1_categories_secondaires_hint: Add one or more complementary activities to better describe your business.
onboarding.s1_categories_secondaires_ph: E.g. Pastry shop, Tea room, Catering
onboarding.s1_section2_subtitle: Describe your activity, your services or products, your specialties, your expertise, what makes you unique, and anything important to help us better understand your business.
onboarding.s1_description_hint: Describe your business in your own words. You can also add any specific or important information about your activity here.
onboarding.s1_description_ph: Example: We are an artisan bakery located in Mâcon, specializing in breads, viennoiseries and pastries. We also make custom cakes for birthdays and events. Our products are baked fresh on site every day with carefully selected ingredients. We also deliver within a 15 km radius.
onboarding.s1_website_hint: Link to your website if you have one.
onboarding.s1_social_networks_hint: Add links to your professional social media pages.
onboarding.s1_google_pas_compte: I don't have a Google account
onboarding.s1_google_perdu_acces: I lost access to my profile
onboarding.s1_google_email_hint_required: Required to access your existing profile.
onboarding.s1_google_email_hint_optional: Optional if you don't have an account.
onboarding.s1_google_email_hint_gmail_required: Due to technical requirements imposed by Google, a @gmail.com address is required to transfer ownership of your profile to you. No Gmail account? Creating one takes only 2 minutes. Simply create one for your business (e.g. mybusiness@gmail.com) using the link below, then enter it here.
onboarding.s1_google_email_hint_any_email: A Gmail address is not required. You can use another email address (Hotmail, Outlook, Yahoo, business address, etc.) as long as it is associated with a Google account.
onboarding.s1_no_google: I don't have a Google account — create one for me
onboarding.s2_desc_ph: Describe your business, strengths, what sets you apart...
onboarding.s2_subtitle: Tell us how customers access your products or services and where you operate.
onboarding.s2_presence_hint: Indicate how your customers can access your products or services.
onboarding.s2_zones_subtitle: List the cities, towns, postal codes or geographic areas where you offer your services.
onboarding.s2_zones_limit: You can add up to 20 service areas.
onboarding.s4_custom_attrs_subtitle: Is a feature specific to your business missing? Add it here.
onboarding.s4_custom_attrs_placeholder: Example: Private parking reserved for customers
onboarding.s5_subtitle: Add photos that present your business professionally and give your future customers an accurate picture of your establishment, your products and your activity.
onboarding.s5_conseils_2: Make sure the lighting is good
onboarding.s5_conseils_4: Show your business as it really is
onboarding.s5_conseils_7: Avoid artificial or excessively AI-generated images
onboarding.s5_conseils_8: Choose photos that best represent your activity
onboarding.s5_logo_subtitle: Add your company's official logo so customers can easily identify you.
onboarding.s5_cover_subtitle: Choose a photo that best represents your business and makes a good first impression on your future customers.
onboarding.s5_exterieur_subtitle: Show your premises from different angles so your customers can easily recognize it when they arrive.
onboarding.s5_exterieur_examples: Examples: facade, entrance, signage, storefront, view from the street, premises from different angles.
onboarding.s5_interieur_subtitle: Show the atmosphere, layout and different spaces your customers can discover in your establishment.
onboarding.s5_interieur_examples: Examples: reception area, main room, customer area, decoration, different spaces of the establishment.
onboarding.s5_equipe_subtitle: Introduce the people who work in your business to give your establishment a more human face.
onboarding.s5_equipe_examples: Examples: full team, team members at work, manager, employees, team in their professional environment.
onboarding.s5_metier_subtitle: Show concretely what you offer your customers: your products, your services or your completed work.
onboarding.s5_metier_examples: Examples: products, services, finished projects, completed work, creations, results achieved, before/after where relevant.
onboarding.s5_limite_depassee: photos could not be added (limit of 10 reached).
onboarding.s5_videos_subtitle: Add short videos showing your business, your products or your services in action. Videos allow your future customers to discover your establishment in a lively, authentic way.
onboarding.s5_videos_examples: Examples: virtual tour, product presentation, service demonstration, customer testimonials, atmosphere of the establishment.
onboarding.s5_videos_limite_depassee: videos could not be added (limit of 5 reached).
onboarding.s5_videos_conseils_1: Keep videos short (30 seconds to 2 minutes)
onboarding.s5_videos_conseils_2: Make sure the picture and sound are of good quality
onboarding.s5_videos_conseils_3: Film in landscape mode for better readability
onboarding.s5_videos_conseils_4: Present your business in an authentic and professional way
onboarding.s5_videos_conseils_5: Avoid overly promotional videos; favor useful content
onboarding.s6_photos_etab_desc: These photos prove to Google that your business physically exists.
onboarding.s6_kbis_desc: Upload your business registration certificate or any legal document of incorporation. PDF, JPG, PNG · Max 10 MB. 🔒 Encrypted private storage.
onboarding.s6_invoice_title: Utility bill at the business address (energy, phone, water...) — required
onboarding.s6_invoice_desc: A recent invoice (less than 6 months) at the business name and address. Serves as second proof to Google. PDF, JPG, PNG · Max 10 MB.
onboarding.s6_subtitle: Check that your business is ready to be created and verified on Google.
onboarding.s6_question: Have you officially registered your business?
onboarding.s6_question_hint: Is your business administratively registered and do you have your registration details (for example your SIRET number)?
onboarding.s6_choice_creee: Yes, my business is officially registered
onboarding.s6_choice_en_cours: My business registration is in progress
onboarding.s6_choice_non_creee: I haven't registered my business yet
onboarding.s6_warning_en_cours_title: ⚠️ Your business registration is still in progress
onboarding.s6_warning_en_cours_text:
We recommend completing your business registration before creating and verifying your Google Business Profile.

An officially registered business generally has more elements to justify its activity and existence if Google requests additional information or proof during verification.

Waiting until your administrative registration is complete can therefore make the verification process easier.
onboarding.s6_warning_non_creee_title: ⚠️ Your business is not registered yet
onboarding.s6_warning_non_creee_text:
We recommend registering your business before continuing with your order.

The creation and verification of a Google Business Profile depend on Google's eligibility criteria and the verification method available for your establishment.

If your business is not officially registered yet, you may not have the necessary elements to answer a possible verification request.

We therefore advise you to complete your business registration before continuing.
onboarding.s6_info_google_text:
After your profile is created, Google will automatically determine the verification method available for your business.

Depending on your situation, Google may offer verification by SMS or phone, email, video, live video call or mail.

Action on your part may be required. If Google asks for confirmation or additional elements, we will contact you so that you can complete the verification with Google.
onboarding.s6_confirmation_label: I have taken note of my current situation and wish to continue with my order.
onboarding.s6_required: Please select an option before continuing.
onboarding.s6_confirm_required: Please tick the confirmation box to continue.
onboarding.s7_terms: I accept the terms and authorize Hotavis to create my Google Business Profile on my behalf.
